newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius sells $17.9 million of treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius sells $17.9 million of treasury bills.

text.p: The central Bank of Mauritius sold 363.3 million rupees ($17.9 million) of treasury bills from a total 600 million rupees it tendered for sale at this week's auction, the bank said on Thursday.

It said it sold 88.0 million rupees of 91-day, 139.3 million rupees of 182-day and 136 million rupees of 364-day bills with average weighted yields of 9.57 percent, 9.60 percent and 9.86 percent respectively.

It posted this week's effective bank rate at 9.94 percent per annum from 9.86 percent last week. Last week, the bank sold 199.5 million rupees of 91-, 182- and 364-day treasury bills with weighted yields of 9.53 percent, 9.60 percent and 9.87 percent respectively.
